values.description: Local Dominance: mean angle down from an observer to the surrounding terrain, high on mounds, low in hollows
Openness (opennessMode positive or negative): mean zenith angle to the horizon, 90 on flat ground, more on summits (positive) or in valleys (negative); the app's ramp reads it minus 90
Sky View Factor, the visible share of the sky, 0 to 1 (1: flat open ground); the app's ramp reads it as a percentage
Local Relief Model: elevation minus its low-pass trend (lrmRadius)
Direction a ridge or valley runs (the dominant gradient axis turned by 90 degrees), clockwise from north, 0 to 180
Eigenvalue ratio λmin/λmax of the gradient structure tensor, 0 (linear: slope, ridge, valley) to 1 (isotropic: peak, pit, saddle); the app's ramp reads it as a percentage
Blobness: det/trace of the gradient structure tensor (a squared slope, unitless); the app's ramp reads it ×100
Shape index (Koenderink and van Doorn): -1 bowl, -0.5 valley, 0 saddle, 0.5 ridge, 1 dome
Roughness: largest elevation difference in the 3x3 window
Topographic Position Index: elevation minus the mean of the 8 neighbours
Terrain Ruggedness Index: mean absolute elevation difference to the 8 neighbours

Slope angle, 0 (flat) to 90 (vertical), Horn's kernel as gdaldem
